adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, decrypted `keys` are processed via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` with no try/catch or validation. If decryption fails (e.g., wrong encryption key) or produces a non-JSON string, `symmetricDecrypt`/`JSON.parse` will throw and the Next.js API route will return an unhandled 500. This behavior is visible at the decrypt/parse line and there’s no surrounding error handling in the diff.
